issue: जय शरणं वरणं नमो नमः — the two nouns have no verb; शरणं वरणं read as 'the choosing of (your) refuge'. वरण is also 'protection, covering' and 'the one to be chosen'.
our reading: Victory! I choose your refuge; salutations, salutations to you.
alternatives: Victory! You are my refuge, my chosen one; salutations, salutations.
